description: Colombia-Pakistan team, an open ocean observatory on NASA Earth data. Juan S. Huertas Olea - research, oceanopolitics, storytelling. Fredy Chaparro - software architecture, frontend/backend, robotics. Juan S. Tinjaca - GIS, remote sensing, satellite imagery, drones, Python. Santiago Calderon - oceanography, phytoplankton, field sampling. Daira Patarroyo - applied research. Moneeb Hussain - mechatronics, SAR data validation and platform testing from Pakistan. Not endorsed by NASA.
